review.otherFindings: Remain scoped as assessed in the archived packet and checkpoint.

portCollision.cause: Changing the four runners to port 0 during parallel focused validation made Vite 8.1.5 choose its default 5173. Three collided with the first runner. Original distinct strict ports were restored.
portCollision.resourceDefect: After logging the listen error, three runners remained live because listen was outside the server-close finally. The agent observed their processes alive for more than three minutes and sent SIGTERM only to those test-owned processes.
portCollision.repair: Move listen inside finally-protected server lifetime; four deliberate occupied-port controls now require exit 2 within 20 seconds and zero mutation credit.

escapedMutation.observation: The mutated test reported pass and the aggregate exited 1 because the mutation survived.
escapedMutation.repair: Record work gate release and disposal in the same renderer; require release before disposal. Await native lock and worker predicates in a bounded Node polling loop.

runnerPreflight.failure: The aggregate source inventory tried to read the untracked node_modules symlink as a file (EISDIR). Excluding that dependency-directory symlink fixed the inventory.

limits: Validation repair only; no production protocol change or whole protocol correctness claim.
Actual full-chain status is recorded separately; partial or superseded attempts do not establish a green aggregate.
No personal browser, factors, Account, app release, relay or deployment is modified.
Other historical harnesses are exercised, not comprehensively audited for assertion strength or all possible timing failures.

compatibilityStartup.failure: The first cold navigation finished before the async fixture module initialized window.compat; the test called seed on undefined.
compatibilityStartup.repair: Wait explicitly for the requested fixture method, and hold module initialization behind a gate in a regression test.

editorRefusalAssertion.failure: Random signature-character XOR sometimes produced noncanonical hex, and the correct parser refusal did not match the expected message regex.
editorRefusalAssertion.repair: Deterministic malformed-hex and canonical invalid-signature cases assert receive-refused inside the browser and unchanged visible content/source captures.
